text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's finish off today with a 
10-round starting dash match!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Today's the day I finally get ahead 
of Bakushin O in wins!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

Beside the lively sprint dash contests, 
Believe was silently putting in her laps.

She is also considered a strong contender 
for the Sprinters Stakes. Naturally, I 
couldn't help but keep an eye on her.
choice_data_list:
Steady and diligent… Like a true 
craftsman, huh.

Steady and diligent… Like a true 
craftsman.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I hear Believe-san's grandfather is an 
actual craftsman."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It simply happened to reach my ears, so 
please do not misunderstand.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems her grandparents live far away. 
She was overjoyed that the Sprinters 
Stakes would finally allow her to show 
them her heroic racing in person.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Sprinters Stakes will be 
broadcast nationwide on TV."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Believe-san, who rarely talks about 
herself, told me she's confirmed to run. 
Fufu, she must have been so happy.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I hear Believe-san aims to run with the 
same perfection as her grandfather's 
craftsmanship."
choice_data_list:
That craftsmanship might be nearing 
perfection.

text_block_list.text:
I watched the footage of her recent races, 
and her race execution was remarkably 
solid.

Her run in the final stretch was 
particularly eye-opening. She didn't let 
up for a single moment until the finish 
line, maintaining top speed for a long 
duration.

She hadn't clinched a graded race win yet, 
but now that her running style is 
perfected, she leaves no openings. She'll 
be a formidable rival in the Sprinters 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Even so, Daitaku Helios also—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! And Durandal, too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some grilled carrots? The 
beach hut is closing up, so they're giving 
out the leftovers on the house!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hey, "while you're at it" is so rude!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Durandal was there. She just 
happened to catch my eye, so I called out 
to her as an afterthought. It really was 
just an afterthought.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's even ruder!
choice_data_list:
Now, now. Let's all go enjoy the treat 
together.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Where is Bakushin O-san?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
After handing out carrots to everyone, she 
headed back to the training camp lodge. 
Just what you'd expect from the class rep.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heeey, Believe!! Don't you want to eat 
toooo?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...No, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's handmade by the old couple running 
the shop! Charcoal-grilled to perfection. 
It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let's eat.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Both Calstone-san and Believe-san look to 
be in great shape, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mm. We shall face the Sprinters Stakes as 
the newborn "Calstone Light O-O"!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Right O-oh...? I-I see... So your special 
training with Bakushin O-san really gave 
you some solid results.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. After all, it's King versus King!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're pretty tough, aren't you, 
Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still... it's a bit surprising. Seeing you 
get help from someone, Right O-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Because I thought Calstone-san was like 
me, mastering her own path all on her 
own..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You model yourself after your grandfather 
too, right? It's the same thing. My mother 
used to say so."

text_block_list.name: Right O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Research isn't something that yields 
results overnight. It takes a long time 
before you finally achieve anything. And 
upon those achievements, new research 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Right O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My mother's research is built upon the 
foundation laid by our predecessors, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Right O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Researching everything from scratch isn't 
very cost-effective, is it? We should 
gratefully use history as our stepping 
stone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I want to run at top 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be so fast I reach the speed of 
light, a realm where no one has ever 
ventured before!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To reach uncharted territory, it's faster 
to just trample over whoever's in front of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I-I think you're misunderstanding what 
"unprecedented" means, but... I see, 
utilizing the achievements of our 
predecessors, huh—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, traditional crafts have improved 
their quality by passing down their 
techniques from generation to generation.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it's only natural as a way of 
life...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The feelings of the Umamusume are just 
like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To become faster, to become stronger. 
Umamusume have poured every ounce of 
effort into that pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
They've also created various techniques to 
become faster, haven't they?

Technology... That would include 
horseshoes and training gear, of course, 
as well as racetrack turf conditions.

As a result of aiming to make it easier to 
generate power while considering injury 
prevention, track surfaces have become 
faster.
choice_data_list:
The feelings of us on the sidelines 
watching the race affect it too.

The feelings of those of us watching the 
races affect things too.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Umamusume racing history, too, has 
evolved upon the foundations of the past.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"History is the crystalized wish of every 
Umamusume from the past who ever yearned 
to 'run faster.'"

Without that history, Calstone Light O's 
speed surely could never have been honed 
this far.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
At the end of accumulated history and 
effort... you are speed. I am karma.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they'll be clashing head-on 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: At the Sprinters Stakes, that is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to object to being left out, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
First, I have to produce results worth 
talking about.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My maiden battle is coming up soon as 
well. One day, I will surely stand 
alongside all of you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it won't be easy catching up to 
'Calstone Light O-o-oh'!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what's with all this "Right 
O-O-O" stuff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Light O-san and Trainer-san, you're 
both early!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! And here I thought I was the first 
one... Beaten by Bakushin O here, too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Because I am the Class Rep! Taking 
roll call for the class is my vital duty!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then I just have to be first in line for 
the bus!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Light O-san circle... wait? That's 
strange, I can't find the name.
choice_data_list: Well, we're in different classes, so...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: !? I completely forgot!
choice_data_list:
We really were together the whole time 
during training camp, weren't we?

We were together the entire training camp, 
after all.

text_block_list.text:
And so, a summer training camp that 
remained lively until the very end came to 
a close.
